name: EdgeDesk CFB Elite Model Dataset Blueprint
grain: one game prediction snapshot per prediction timestamp

sign_convention.pure_model_margin: positive = home projected to win by N
sign_convention.book_spread_home: RECOMMENDED internal convention: home expected margin; positive = home favored. Convert provider conventions at ingest boundary.
sign_convention.warning: Do not mix sportsbook display convention (often home -3) with internal home-margin convention (+3). Add automated sign tests.

snapshot_policy.rule: Every feature must be reconstructible using only information known at prediction_ts.

layers.market: sportsbook/external-market inputs after pure projection is frozen

ensemble_policy: Generate strict walk-forward out-of-fold predictions for every submodel, then fit non-negative stacking weights (prefer sum-to-one unless validation clearly supports another constraint).
calibration_policy: Calibrate win/cover probabilities strictly out-of-sample; track Brier, log loss and reliability curves.
